featured_reviews.review_text:
Deeply unprofessional and disrespectful – Avoid House of Vivaah at all costs. There is a reason their Google rating is 2.8 only inspite of such a large following.

We had an extremely poor experience with House of Vivaah as our wedding decorators, and I would strongly discourage anyone from working with them.

We initially coordinated with Mr. Shailendra, who was nowhere to be seen on the wedding day without any prior communication. Instead, Ms. Aashi, a junior team member, was present briefly and left before the event even began. No one informed us who was handling things onsite after that.

From there, it only went downhill:
•	The mandap backdrop was changed without our knowledge or approval.
•	Entry props were never shown to us until the day of the event, and they did not match the agreed-upon dimensions or design.
•	We raised these concerns with Aashi post-event, and instead of responding, she removed us from the WhatsApp group.
•	We sent an email, which was completely ignored for over a month, until we had to WhatsApp the owner, Ms. Rachna, to finally get a response.

In the follow-up meeting, things went from bad to worse:
•	Ms. Aashi, despite being present, had no answers or accountability regarding the changes.
•	When shown the difference between the promised and delivered mandap backdrop, Ms. Rachna had the audacity to tell the bride, “This is your first wedding, I’ve been doing this for years,” and referred to her as “a fussy bride.” This was said in an attempt to deflect from the very valid and noticeable issue with the changed decor, which Aashi and Rachna’s sister Mamta had already agreed to being different from what was agreed upon. The email reply a month after the event from Mamta cited “budget restrictions” as the reason for changing the mandap, but the in person meeting showed no one had any clarity as to why it was done. Rachna said she “thought” that was the reason - as if this is any resolution.
•	Instead of asking her employee Aashi to provide proof of the work done, Rachna kept demanding that the bride provide photographic evidence – as if the bride should have been busy documenting decor errors during her own wedding. Completely unreasonable and disrespectful.
•	Adding to that, Ms. Rachna walked out of the meeting midway without any notice, and dropped in and out as per her convenience — further showing her lack of interest, professionalism, or respect for the situation.
- Mamta even asked us to get back after another 15 days once Shailendra is back in town, as if we have no work apart from chasing them for a reply and clearly showing that meeting the two owners was of no point because they are clueless about everything (inspite of a detailed email being sent a month prior).

What became glaringly obvious throughout this process was:
•	A total lack of team coordination
•	Zero accountability
•	Complete disregard for post-event resolution
•	A dismissive, rude attitude once full payment was received

Their Google rating of 2.8 stars speaks for itself — and reflects a consistent pattern of mismanagement and client dissatisfaction, which is clearly visible in many other reviews as well.

In summary:
•	Major changes were made without our consent
•	Communication was poor and unprofessional
•	The owner and her team are disconnected and dismissive
•	The bride was insulted for raising genuine concerns
•	No one was willing to take responsibility

Avoid House of Vivaah if you value professionalism, transparency, and respect for your event. We regret trusting them with our wedding day and hope no other couple has to go through this kind of experience.

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Bagade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dadi always said, ‘ghar pahave bandhun ani lagna pahave karun’, translated it means, experience the joy and efforts in building a house and marrying.
Wedding is the most important day, definitely, but it is finale of 1000 different things planned in the backend to all work in sync to perfection on the day to make it happen.
These 1000 things, fortunately for us, was just 1 - Panaash Entertainment. Our wedding planner. Everything delivered, all demands, realistic or unrealistic, fulfilled, all activities planned, conceptualised and executed to perfection with a smile that never goes away.

From pre-wedding photoshoot where the team worked tirelessly continuously for hours and won us over to the 2 wedding days and the receptions that followed, we just had to call Panaash and we knew the task is done. Managing this entire thing between 2 cities and a pandemic, Yash and Mayur made sure that these 2 days became the most memorable 2 days because we didn’t have to worry about anything but our expressions in the photos!!!!

Yash with his trademark, ‘haan ho jaega’ and Mayur with his, ‘aare aap tension kyu le rahe ho, hum dekh lenge’, deliver what they promise - if you know me, you know it will be done.

Trust Yash and Mayur to only make your big day even better and more memorable. Knowing them for managing our wedding as well as my Brother-in-law’s within a span of 2 months, highly recommend this duo, with their tireless team! Thanks a lot Yash, Mayur and the entire team at Panaash! You guys rock :)
